title.narrative: Stakeholder Engagement - Review of the Current Landscape and Future Prospects of Engineering Biology in Malaysia and Thailand

description.narrative:
The overarching Project aims to gain insights and recommendations on the current landscape, as well as forward-looking opportunities (foresight) for Malaysia and Thailand government as well as all stakeholders working towards the development and implementation of engineering biology systems, as well as for the interested UK stakeholders.
Specifically for this stakeholder engagement activity, we will host a session in the Thailand’s Synbio Consortium Meeting on 11 November 2024. As the Meeting will convene already key EngBio stakeholders (policy-makers such as the Science Policy Council, academia, and industries) in Thailand, this presents a great opportunity for Thailand Academy of Science and Technology to not only outline the preliminary study of Thailand EngBio landscape, but also to consult with all relevant stakeholders during the meeting, and to conduct foresight study in one go. The Project will also help to provide insights into specific areas with opportunities for the UK to further engage, both on business and research side.
